description: This PHP source file defines the class `exec_cfield_mgr`, which manages custom fields related to test execution within the TestLink project. It includes methods for generating HTML input tables, retrieving linked custom fields for a project, and obtaining user-set filter values, among other functionalities.

classes.name: exec_cfield_mgr
classes.description: A class extending cfield_mgr, dedicated to managing custom fields for test execution contexts in TestLink.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the class with a database reference and project ID, and fetching linked custom fields.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_inputs
methods.description: Generates an HTML table of input elements for custom fields, considering their types and sizes.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields
methods.description: Retrieves custom fields linked for a specific project, filtering out non-relevant types such as text areas and dates.

methods.name: field_names
methods.description: Returns an array of custom field identifiers and related metadata for the current project context.

methods.name: get_set_values
methods.description: Retrieves user-selected filter values for custom fields, processed based on their input types.
